app.name: BorrowBox
app.tagline: Borrow what you need from your neighbours

login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Welcome back! Sign in to continue.

register.title: Create your account
register.subtitle: Join your neighbours and start borrowing in a minute.
register.passwordHint: 8–64 characters, with at least one letter and one digit

export.title: Download your data
export.description: Get a copy of the personal data BorrowBox holds about you, as a JSON file.

delete.title: Delete your account
delete.description: Your personal data will be erased. Records we must keep by law (e.g. payments) are anonymised. This cannot be undone.

payouts.title: Payouts
payouts.description: To accept paid bookings, set up the Stripe account BorrowBox pays you through.

deleteDialog.title: Delete your account?
deleteDialog.body: This permanently deletes your account and signs you out everywhere.
deleteDialog.noPassword: For your security, you need to have signed in within the last 5 minutes.

lend.title: Lend your things
lend.text: Earn a little from things you rarely use. Listing one takes a few minutes.

find.title: Find it nearby

payouts.title: Payouts
payouts.intro: BorrowBox pays lenders through Stripe. Stripe asks for your bank account and checks your identity on its own pages; BorrowBox never sees those details.
payouts.opening: Opening Stripe… This can take up to a minute.

NOT_STARTED.title: Not set up yet
NOT_STARTED.text: Set up payouts to accept bookings that cost something. Free bookings don’t need them.

INCOMPLETE.title: Details missing
INCOMPLETE.text: Stripe still needs some details from you. Continue where you left off.

PENDING.title: Being checked
PENDING.text: Stripe is checking your details. This usually takes a few minutes; come back to this page to see the result.

READY.title: Ready
READY.text: Payouts are set up: you can accept paid bookings.

RESTRICTED.title: Paused by Stripe
RESTRICTED.text: Stripe has paused payouts to your account, usually because it needs updated details. Until then you can’t accept paid bookings.

payouts.payoutsDisabled: Stripe hasn’t enabled payouts to your bank yet. Your Stripe dashboard shows what’s missing.
payouts.linkExpired: The Stripe page expired before you finished. Continue with a new one.
payouts.verifyFirst: Confirm your email address before setting up payouts.
payouts.dashboardHint: The dashboard opens in this tab. There you can see your payouts and change your bank account.

how.title: How you get paid
how.stripe: Stripe holds your payout details and pays your balance into your bank account.
how.transfer: The renter pays when you accept. BorrowBox transfers the rent to you after the rental, minus a small fee if you asked for a deposit.
how.deposit: The deposit goes back to the renter after the item is returned.
